decks.notes: The main concept of this deck is to aggressively deal damage to the opponent as quickly as possible using efficient and low-cost burn spells and creatures like Goblin Guide and Monastery Swiftspear. With a focus on cards that deal direct damage and punish opponents for casting spells, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and finish the game before they can stabilize. The mana base is optimized for consistency and speed, allowing the deck to consistently cast its spells and maintain pressure on the opponent.

The deck is focused on quickly dealing damage to the opponent using low-cost creatures and burn spells. It aims to put pressure on the opponent early in the game and finish them off before they can establish a board presence. The deck includes a mix of aggressive creatures like Goblin Guide and Monastery Swiftspear, along with efficient burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Lava Spike to deal direct damage to the opponent. It also includes spells like Boros Charm and Skullcrack to protect its creatures and prevent the opponent from gaining life.

The deck focuses on aggressive plays and overwhelming the opponent with a fast and efficient creature base, using cards like Goblin Guide, Wild Nacatl, and Kird Ape to apply early pressure. By utilizing cards such as Reckless Bushwhacker and Ghor-Clan Rampager, the deck can make explosive plays to quickly close out games. The inclusion of burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Atarka's Command allows for reach and removal, ensuring the opponent can't stabilize. The deck aims to win the game quickly and decisively before the opponent can establish their own game plan.

The deck focuses on creating infinite combos by copying creatures and triggering their enter the battlefield abilities multiple times. It uses a combination of cards like Kiki-Jiki, Mirror Breaker, Felidar Guardian, and Saheeli Rai to create infinite copies of creatures such as Omnath, Locus of Creation or Karmic Guide, generating immense value and overwhelming the opponent. It also includes support cards like Renegade Rallier and Prismatic Ending to interact with the opponent's board and control the game state. The deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and win the game in a single explosive turn.

The deck focuses on using powerful Eldrazi creatures such as Reality Smasher and Thought-Knot Seer to quickly overwhelm opponents with aggressive plays. It also includes disruptive elements like Chalice of the Void and Relic of Progenitus to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck also utilizes Planeswalkers like Karn Liberated and Ugin, the Spirit Dragon to generate additional value and close out games. Additionally, the deck includes utility lands like Urza's Saga and Eldrazi Temple to support the aggressive game plan and ensure consistency in mana production.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly assemble the combo pieces needed to equip Colossus Hammer onto a creature, such as Ornithopter or Gingerbrute, and deal a massive amount of damage in just one swing. The deck utilizes cards like Puresteel Paladin, Stoneforge Mystic, and Sigarda's Aid to cheat equipment onto the battlefield and generate card advantage. Additionally, the deck includes cards like Esper Sentinel and The Reality Chip to disrupt the opponent's game plan and keep the pressure on. The land base also supports the combo strategy with Inkmoth Nexus serving as an additional win condition.

The main concept of this Combo - Living End deck is to cycle through creatures like Colossal Skyturtle, Waker of Waves, and Striped Riverwinder using cards like Street Wraith and Shardless Agent. By utilizing cards such as Grief and Curator of Mysteries, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while setting up for a game-winning play with Living End. Violent Outburst provides a way to quickly cast Living End, while cards like Force of Negation offer protection. The mana base enables the deck to consistently cast its spells and bring back a board full of powerful creatures.

This Merfolk deck focuses on quickly developing a board presence with efficient creatures that buff each other and disrupt opponents. By utilizing cards like Lord of Atlantis and Master of the Pearl Trident, as well as Aether Vial to cheat creatures into play, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a fast and aggressive strategy. The inclusion of disruptive cards like Unsettled Mariner and Merfolk Trickster help control the board while Tide Shaper and Svyelun of Sea and Sky provide additional buffing and protection for the Merfolk tribe.

The main focus of this Merfolk deck is to quickly establish a strong board presence and apply pressure on the opponent through aggressive creatures and disruptive spells. The deck aims to use cards like Master of the Pearl Trident and Lord of Atlantis to pump up the Merfolk creatures, while also utilizing cards like Merfolk Trickster and Harbinger of the Tides to disrupt the opponent's board state. The inclusion of Aether Vial allows for creatures to be played at instant speed, adding an element of surprise to the deck's strategy. The mana base focuses on maximizing Island cards to ensure smooth and consistent mana production.

The main concept of this Merfolk aggro deck is to quickly establish a board presence with efficient Merfolk creatures like Lord of Atlantis and Master of the Pearl Trident, while disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Merfolk Trickster and Tide Shaper. The deck also includes synergy with cards like Svyelun of Sea and Sky and Merrow Reejerey to generate additional value. With the addition of disruptive elements like Subtlety and Magus of the Moon, the deck aims to apply early pressure and maintain control of the board throughout the game.

The deck focuses on using graveyard recursion to reanimate powerful creatures and disrupt the opponent's strategy with counterspells and removal spells. By utilizing cards like Unburial Rites and Persist, the deck aims to quickly bring out high-impact creatures like Archon of Cruelty and The Wandering Emperor. The inclusion of disruptive cards such as Counterspell and Teferi, Time Raveler also helps to control the pace of the game. Liliana of the Veil and Faithful Mending provide additional graveyard manipulation and card advantage to help fuel the combo strategy.

The main focus of this Spirit Aggro deck is to quickly establish a board presence with low-cost creatures like Shacklegeist and Mausoleum Wanderer, supported by powerful tribal synergies such as Drogskol Captain and Supreme Phantom. Aether Vial allows for creatures to be deployed at instant speed, while disruptive spells like Spell Queller and Rattlechains help control the opponent's game plan. The deck aims to consistently apply pressure and disrupt the opponent's plans, leading to a fast victory through aggressive creature combat and tempo plays.

The core strategy of this deck revolves around utilizing The Underworld Cookbook to fuel graveyard recursion and card advantage, while also enabling powerful artifact synergies and combo pieces like Thopter Foundry and Sword of the Meek. Aggressively milling and recurring key cards with Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Unearth allows for explosive plays and overwhelming board presence, supported by disruptive elements like Urza's Saga and Mishra's Bauble. With a focus on speed, resilience, and resource management, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a relentless combination of aggression and combo potential.

The deck's primary focus is to mill the opponent's library quickly using cards like Ruin Crab, Hedron Crab, Archive Trap, and Fractured Sanity. It also includes disruption spells like Drown in the Loch, Fatal Push, and Assassin's Trophy to control the board and protect the combo. The deck also includes cards like Tasha's Hideous Laughter and Crypt Incursion to disrupt graveyard strategies. The mana base includes a mix of lands to ensure consistency and versatility in casting spells. The deck aims to win through decking the opponent out and utilizing graveyard hate to disrupt their game plan.

The main concept of this deck is to play aggressive creatures such as Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent, while also utilizing disruptive spells like Lightning Bolt and Counterspell to control the opponent's board. The deck aims to apply pressure early on with efficient threats like Dragon's Rage Channeler and finish off the opponent quickly. The inclusion of Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration helps with card selection and consistency, allowing the deck to maintain a consistent aggressive game plan throughout the match.

The key concept of this deck is to maintain control on the board while applying constant pressure with efficient creatures and removal spells. By utilizing cards like Dragon's Rage Channeler and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, alongside disruption and tempo plays from cards such as Spell Pierce and Lightning Bolt, the deck aims to diminish the opponent's resources while building up its own advantage. Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration help to filter through the deck and find key pieces. Ultimately, the deck seeks to overwhelm opponents with a mix of aggression and control elements in order to secure a swift victory.

The deck focuses on swift and aggressive creature plays, utilizing cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dragon's Rage Channeler to deal damage quickly. It also includes efficient removal spells like Unholy Heat and Lightning Bolt to control the board. The Counterspell and Spell Pierce provide protection for your creatures, while Mishra's Bauble, Expressive Iteration, and Archmage's Charm help with card advantage and selection. The mana base ensures a smooth curve with options for all colors needed. Overall, the deck aims to apply pressure early and maintain tempo throughout the game.

This deck focuses on playing aggressively by quickly playing threats like Murktide Regent, Dragon's Rage Channeler, and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer. It also utilizes cards like Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration to draw into more threats while disrupting the opponent's game plan with counterspells like Counterspell and Archmage's Charm. Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat provide additional removal options. The deck seeks to control the board while applying pressure with efficient creatures, burn spells, and disruption, aiming to close out the game quickly before the opponent can stabilize.

This UR Aggro deck focuses on using efficient creatures like Dragon's Rage Channeler and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer to apply pressure early on. By combining disruption spells like Counterspell and Inquisition of Kozilek with removal like Unholy Heat, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while maintaining a steady stream of threats. The deck also utilizes card draw and selection with Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration to ensure consistent draws and maximize efficiency. The mana base is optimized for quick access to both red and blue mana sources to support the aggressive game plan.

The deck focuses on controlling the game by utilizing counterspells and removal spells to disrupt the opponent's game plan. It also utilizes powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Jace, and The Wandering Emperor to generate card advantage and provide additional control elements. The deck aims to stabilize the board with cards like Supreme Verdict and then close out the game with powerful finishers like Shark Typhoon or Hall of Storm Giants. The manabase is built to support the deck's color requirements and ensure consistent access to all spells.
